# Chunghwa Telecom August Revenue NT$23.31 Billion Revenue, Operating income, EBITDA and EPS All Hit Record Highs for August ICT Contract Value Surpasses Full-Year Target


2026/09/10


Chunghwa Telecom announced its unaudited consolidated operating results for August 2026. In August, the unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$23.31 billion. Operating income was NT$5.62 billion, and income before tax was NT$5.65 billion. Net income attributable to stockholders of the parent company was NT$4.44 billion and EBITDA reached NT$9.05 billion, while EPS was NT$0.57.


Revenue, operating income, EBITDA and EPS all reached record highs for the same period in August.


“We are pleased to see the continued success of our diversified growth strategy. Building on the solid foundation of our core telecom business, we have actively captured opportunities arising from AI and next-generation digital infrastructure, driving growth across multiple business segments while enhancing asset utilization efficiency and overall operating performance. Going forward, we will continue to strengthen our core business advantages and expand new growth opportunities, transforming market opportunities into sustainable long-term growth and creating value for our shareholders.”


said Mr. Chih-Cheng Chien, Chairman and CEO of Chunghwa Telecom.


Chunghwa Telecom highlighted that ICT and other revenue delivered strong growth momentum in August, increasing by 100% year-over-year. In particular, ICT revenue grew by more than 50% year-over-year, mainly driven by large-scale IDC cloud installation projects, transportation information system integration projects, and smart energy projects. As a result, our core ICT service pillars, including IDC and cloud, AIoT and cybersecurity services, all delivered double-digit year-over-year revenue growth. Notably, ICT business has delivered better-than-expected performance in securing orders. As of August, the accumulated contract value of ICT business has surpassed the Company's full-year target ahead of schedule, hitting a record high for the same period. This achievement not only enhances the visibility of future business growth but also reflects continuous expansion of demand for AI and next-generation digital infrastructure, further reinforcing Chunghwa Telecom's leadership position in the ICT market.


In addition to the continuous growth of the ICT business, the Company's active efforts in promoting asset revitalization have also yielded excellent results. This contributed a one-off gain in August, reflecting enhanced asset utilization efficiency and creating value for shareholders.


The sales revenue also delivered strong results in August, benefiting from strong iPhone17 sales and solid demand from consumer electronics products, alongside increased revenues from subsidiaries fueled by AI demand, resulting in double-digit year-over-year growth in total sales revenues.


Moreover, telecom core services continued to demonstrate steady growth. Mobile service revenue increased by nearly 3% year over year, supported by continued 5G speed upgrades, a growing number of 5G migration subscribers, as well as stronger roaming demand. Fixed broadband revenue increased 3.4% year over year as subscribers using 300Mbps-or-higher packages grew 14.3% year over year, driven by ongoing digital transformation and AI adoption and serving as a strong pillar in the core telecom service growth.


In addition, the network resilience business delivered an impressive performance. Demand for international submarine cable leases has increased steadily. In August, driven by growing cross-border transmission demand from AI supply chain customers, international private leased circuit (IPLC) revenue surged by over 60% year-on-year. Looking ahead, given the ramp up of AI driven data traffic and the growing international connectivity demand, the benefits of our Sea-Land-Sky network deployment are increasingly paying off, continuously strengthening the Company's key position as an Asia-Pacific digital hub.


As of August 2026, the accumulated unaudited consolidated revenue was NT$164.55 billion. Operating income was NT$36.43 billion and income before tax was NT$37.26 billion. Net income attributable to stockholders of the parent was NT$28.53 billion and EPS was NT$3.68. Revenue, operating income, income before tax, net income attributable to stockholders of the parent and EPS all exceeded guidance.

**About Chunghwa Telecom**


Chunghwa Telecom (TAIEX 2412, NYSE: CHT) (“Chunghwa” or “the Company”) is Taiwan’s largest integrated telecommunications services company that provides fixed-line, mobile, broadband, and internet services. The Company also provides information and communication technology services to corporate customers with its big data, information security, cloud computing and IDC capabilities, and is expanding its business into innovative technology services such as IoT, AI, etc. Chunghwa has been actively and continuously implemented environmental, social and governance (ESG) initiatives with the goal to achieve sustainability and has won numerous international and domestic awards and recognitions for its ESG commitments and best practices. For more information, please visit our website at www.cht.com.tw
